name: DNAture walking companions and experience choices

provenance.type: New AI-generated walking illustrations converted into native SVG paths; authored vector navigation motifs
provenance.method: Distinct walking poses generated for each scene, then traced with vtracer 0.6.15 into ink/mint paths. No animal paths are reused from the original species-selection assets. No embedded bitmap, external dependency, filter or font in the SVGs.

assets.motif: New dog and cat walk right together and exchange a glance; signpost and one route
Cat walks outward left and dog outward right, choosing opposite branches from one central fork; compass above

usage_rules: Both experiences support cats and dogs. The guided pair walks together; the exploration pair parts calmly toward opposite branches.
Preserve each pair's natural walking gait and intended directions; do not substitute the old standing dog or crouching cat.
Keep the experience name visible beside the artwork; the illustration does not replace the control label.
Use empty alt when the adjacent control already supplies the experience name.
Place directly on a continuous light surface. Preserve the 4:3 experience canvas and the intrinsic ratio of standalone pairs.
Do not add cards, circular masks, shadows, or category colors.
Orange is the approved brand accent, not a product category identifier.
The artwork is static. Any UI reveal must honor reduced motion.
